title: dock
description: App dock: pinned and running apps, its style (default/floating/integrated into the bar), edge, size and auto-hide.

enabled.title: Show the dock
enabled.description: A dock with pinned and running apps.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.enabled
x-settings.keywords: dock enable show hide on off

theme.title: Dock style
theme.description: Default sits on the edge, floating detaches from it, integrated puts the apps inside the bar.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.theme
x-settings.keywords: dock style theme floating integrated bar inside

position.title: Dock edge
position.description: Screen edge the dock sits on.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.position
x-settings.keywords: dock position edge top bottom left right vertical

height.title: Dock thickness
height.description: Height of a horizontal dock, width of a vertical one.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.height
x-settings.keywords: dock height thickness size width

iconSize.title: Dock icon size
iconSize.description: Size of the app icons in the dock.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.icon_size
x-settings.keywords: dock icon size apps big small

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.spacing
x-settings.keywords: dock spacing gap between icons

margin.title: Dock edge margin
margin.description: Distance between the dock and the screen edge.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.margin
x-settings.keywords: dock margin distance edge offset

hoverRegionHeight.title: Dock reveal strip
hoverRegionHeight.description: Size of the invisible edge strip that reveals the hidden dock.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.hover_region
x-settings.keywords: dock hover region trigger strip area reveal

pinnedOnStartup.title: Pin the dock at startup
pinnedOnStartup.description: The dock starts always visible instead of hiding.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.pinned
x-settings.keywords: dock pin autohide hide show startup always visible

hoverToReveal.title: Reveal the dock on hover
hoverToReveal.description: Show the hidden dock when the pointer touches its edge.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.hover_reveal
x-settings.keywords: dock hover reveal mouse edge autohide

availableOnFullscreen.title: Dock over fullscreen apps
availableOnFullscreen.description: Allow revealing the dock over fullscreen windows.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.fullscreen
x-settings.keywords: dock fullscreen game video overlay

showRunningIndicators.title: Running app dots
showRunningIndicators.description: Mark apps that have open windows.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.running
x-settings.keywords: dock running indicators dots open apps

indicator.title: Indicator style
indicator.description: How running apps are marked; it follows the edge the dock is on.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.indicator
x-settings.keywords: dock indicator running dot line glow brush style

showPinButton.title: Dock pin button
showPinButton.description: A button that keeps the dock visible.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.pin_button
x-settings.keywords: dock pin button keep visible

showOverviewButton.title: Dock overview button
showOverviewButton.description: A button that opens the workspace overview.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.overview_button
x-settings.keywords: dock overview button workspaces mission control

ignoredAppRegexes.title: Apps hidden from the dock
ignoredAppRegexes.description: App ids matching one of these regular expressions never appear in the dock.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.ignored
x-settings.keywords: dock ignore hide apps regex filter exclude app id class

screenList.title: Dock monitors
screenList.description: Monitors that show the dock; none selected shows it on every monitor.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.screens
x-settings.keywords: dock monitor screen display multi-monitor where

keepHidden.title: Hide the dock on empty desktops
keepHidden.description: Keep the dock hidden even when no window covers it, until it is revealed.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.keep_hidden
x-settings.keywords: dock keep hidden autohide windows empty desktop

magnification.title: Magnify icons on hover
magnification.description: Grow the icon under the pointer, in the dock and dock-style bar panels.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.magnification
x-settings.keywords: dock magnification zoom magnify icons hover macos

magnificationScale.title: Magnification amount
magnificationScale.description: Size of the icon under the pointer when magnifying.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.magnification_scale
x-settings.keywords: dock magnification scale zoom amount size

launchBounce.title: Bounce on launch
launchBounce.description: Bounce an app icon while the app is starting.

x-settings.label: prefs.dock.launch_bounce
x-settings.keywords: dock launch bounce animation opening app
